'''CZ-198''' was an exotic [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TORweb-TITANS OF INDUSTRY">{{TORweb|url=gameupdates/titans_of_industry|text=TITANS OF INDUSTRY}}</ref> orbiting a [[Unidentified planet (CZ-198)|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="location">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|CZ-198}}</ref> The moon was bought by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] which gave it its designation and used it as a warehouse facility. Under the supervision of Czerka Special Executive [[Rasmus Blys]], the moon became the location for one of the most advanced product development facilities created by the corporation.<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|CZ-198}}</ref>

==Description==
[[File:CZ-198.png|thumb|left|180px|The moon's surface]]
The moon had orange sky and thick air.<ref name="location" /> The only point of interest on the lifeless rocky landscape was the [[Czerka facility (CZ-198)|Czerka facility]] turned by [[Rasmus Blys]] into a cutting edge development laboratory.<ref name="czerka labs">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=flashpoint|Czerka Corporate Labs}}</ref> After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] nationalized [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] and Rasmus Bls went rogue, the moon was locked down and [[Seizure of CZ-198|stormed]] by the strike teams of both Republic and [[Sith Empire/Legends|Imperial]] affiliation, establishing a presence on the moon for both factions.<ref name="titans">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=other|"Titans of Industry" storyline, available for both Republic and Imperial players}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The CZ-198 facility is featured in a Developer Blog on ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' official website providing a virtual tour of the Czerka site.<ref name="FTVT" />
